data.long_description:
Live in one of Dubai’s most serene and family-friendly neighborhoods with this well-maintained villa in Springs 11, now vacant and ready for immediate move-in. The property is back to back and is within walking distance to the communal pool and park. The property also benefits from covered parking, family garden and a study.

• Type 4E (corner unit)
•  Bed + Study
• 2,845 sq ft
• Close to pool and park
• Well Maintained
• Huge landscaped garden
• 3 bathrooms
• 2 parking

With its prime location, family-friendly atmosphere, and easy access to key roads and amenities, Springs 11 is an ideal choice for those seeking a peaceful yet well-connected lifestyle in the heart of The Springs. Whether you're a homeowner or investor, this community offers a perfect blend of comfort, security, and convenience.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
